## Load Saved Model
```{r load-saved-model, eval=FALSE}
model <- readRDS("bayes_model_fit_4.rds")
```

## Outcomes
```{r summary}
library("pROC")
summary(model)

pred_probs <- fitted(model)[, "Estimate"]
pred_class <- ifelse(pred_probs > 0.5, 1, 0)

mean(pred_class == pets_scaled$AdoptionLikelihood)

roc_obj <- roc(pets_scaled$AdoptionLikelihood, pred_probs)
auc(roc_obj)
```
